text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down the hallway, I saw
Biwa Hayahide groaning in front of a windowpane.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Mmph...
I haven't even settled on the sides yet...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's the usual thing—my hair just won't behave.
Maybe it's worse today because of the humidity... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for troubling you each time, but could you check
what's going on with my back? The ticke—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: F-Forgive me! Please forget what just happened. I simply assumed the tickets had arrived...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... What in the world am I doing...

Letting out a sigh,
Biwa Hayahide took her leave.
